purpose: Metadata-only triage derived from the 32-sample structural audit in issue #55. This is not final corpus admission and contains no Joel prose.
rules: No sample is admitted solely because structural flags are absent.
Samples with possible-unremoved-dialogue require manual authored-boundary review.
Samples under 250 words are thin for standalone attribution and should be pooled only within their own source group or excluded from standalone evaluation.
Zero-word named-speaker results indicate extractor failure or page-format mismatch, not absence of Joel text.
Blockquote removal is acceptable only after confirming the retained prose is Joel-authored and the removed blockquote is third-party material.
Final admission requires canonical hash, word count, provenance, modality, register, source_group, duplicate audit, and manual review status.

high_value_manual_review_candidates.reason: long personal/polemical source; no quality flag; minor extraction removal only
message-by-you extraction retained a focused Joel-only subset; no quality flag
political register; no quality flag; small extraction removal
political/journalistic register; no quality flag after substantial blockquote removal; retained author boundary needs manual confirmation

parser_hypothesis: Current speaker-prefix extraction requires the speaker label and authored text to survive HTML parsing on the same line. Blogger discussion markup may separate `Joel Rosenblum:` from the body across nested elements/line breaks. Fix conservatively with a speaker-state parser that starts only on an explicit Joel label and stops at the next explicit speaker/timestamp boundary; add fixtures before rerunning the Dharma tranche.
recommended_order: Fix and regression-test the Dharma named-speaker extractor.
Manually inspect the three structurally unflagged samples plus the four high-value no-quality-flag samples.
Resolve possible-unremoved-dialogue candidates by narrowing extraction or excluding third-party turns.
Pool or exclude thin love4nanou samples without crossing source-group boundaries.
After manual admission, freeze hashes/counts and only then assign profile/validation/test splits.
